answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is locked for a full epoch and slashed if peers prove duplicate control. A new identity starts dim, like a lantern behind ivory glass: it can only take small jobs, and each completed job sends a small ripple of reputation outward to the distinct peers it served. Forging a thousand fake identities would mean locking a thousand stakes and doing a thousand real jobs, so the cost of a Sybil swarm exceeds any gain from faking trust.
